Inductive: sees repeated patterns such as (S6, Q7,K4) recognizes that repeated ciphers clusters likely corresponds to repeated letters or parts of the password also generalizes Tom uses these types of ciphers and its consistent across pages and then generalizes that the boxed clusters belong to the BANK semantics category.
